text_en: Praise the Lord ! Sing to the Lord a new song, his praise in the assembly of the faithful.
text_cn: 亚肋路亚！ 请你们向上主讴唱新歌， 在圣者集会中向他祝贺！

text_en: Let Israel be glad in its Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
text_cn: 愿以色列因自己的创造者而踊跃， 愿熙雍子民因自己的君王而欢乐！

text_en: Let them praise his name with dancing, making melody to him with tambourine and lyre.
text_cn: 愿他们以舞蹈赞美上主的名， 愿他们敲鼓弹琴向上主歌咏！

text_en: For the Lord takes pleasure in his people; he adorns the humble with victory.
text_cn: 因为上主喜爱自己的百姓， 赏赐谦虚的人凯旋而得胜。

text_en: Let the faithful exult in glory; let them sing for joy on their couches.
text_cn: 愿圣徒因所受的光荣而喜庆， 在自己的床榻上欢呼而歌颂。

text_en: Let the high praises of God be in their throats and two-edged swords in their hands,
text_cn: 愿赞美天主的歌辞在他们的口中， 愿双刃的宝剑掌握在他们的手中，

text_en: to execute vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
text_cn: 为向异邦报仇雪耻， 为向列国进攻袭击，

text_en: to bind their kings with fetters and their nobles with chains of iron,
text_cn: 要用锁链捆住他们的国君， 要用铐镣锁住他们的缙绅，

text_en: to execute on them the judgment decreed. This is glory for all his faithful ones. Praise the Lord !
text_cn: 为向他们施行经上的审讯。 这也就是一切圣徒的光荣。
